```csharp
using System;
using Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.CosmosNoSql;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Tests
{
    public class CosmosNoSqlServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void AddKeyedCosmosNoSqlVectorStore_RegistersServices_AndResolvesDatabase()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            // Add a mock Database service to the service collection
            var mockDatabase = new MockDatabase();
            services.AddSingleton(mockDatabase);

            // Act
            services.AddKeyedCosmosNoSqlVectorStore(serviceKey: null);

            var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            // Assert
            // The CosmosNoSqlVectorStore service should be resolvable and use the registered Database
            var vectorStore = provider.GetRequiredService<CosmosNoSqlVectorStore>();
            Assert.NotNull(vectorStore);
            Assert.Same(mockDatabase, vectorStore.DatabaseInstance);
        }

        // A minimal mock Database class to test the service registration and resolution
        private class MockDatabase : Database
        {
            public MockDatabase() : base(null!, false) { }

            // Expose a property to verify the instance used in CosmosNoSqlVectorStore
            public string Id => "MockDatabase";

            // We override ToString to help with debugging if needed
            public override string ToString() => Id;
        }
    }
}
```

The type `Database` is from the `Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos` namespace, so it is part of the Azure Cosmos SDK, not defined in this repo. To test the call to `GetRequiredService<Database>()` in the extension method, I will create a minimal fake `Database` class that implements the minimal interface needed for the test, and register it in the service collection. I will also refactor the extension method to make the factory delegate virtual so I can override it in the test to inject the fake database.

I will apply the `make_virtual` refactor to the lambda method that calls `GetRequiredService<Database>()` to enable overriding it in the test. Then I will write a test that registers a fake `Database` and verifies that the `CosmosNoSqlVectorStore` is created with that database instance.
